title: Lots of great features
review: I love this app, I ended up paying for the subscription by accident but the importing features are really nice so I'm still glad I have it. My only issue is that the app is still a little glitchy: sometimes you can tag a recipe with the cuisine type and then the tag won't save; sometimes while editing a recipe I am locked out of editing text; sometimes the URL detection pops up and the orange button to paste is missing.

title: Loving it so far
review: I've been loving this app so far! Have had very good success with most of my imports. I love how easily it is to just adjust things if there are mistakes. The overall layout of the app is sleek, easy to read, and navigate. I love the meal prep feature the app has as well. The grocery list that is created for you is incredibly helpful.

title: The app I didn't know I needed
review: I rarely will try an app if I have to sign up for a subscription and then cancel it after the trial. With this one, it was worth it because they gave me enough time in the trial to really try it out. I have thousands of recipes saved in various corners of the interwebs and I rarely go back to them. I love that ReciMe imports the recipe (from just about anywhere) and then saves it.

title: For the organization girlies
review: The only review I've made because I'm that impressed. It organizes perfectly, it jots down information from a VIDEO without a caption. They thought of everything to make it extremely user friendly. It even tells you the nutritional facts for 1 serving.

title: Time saver!
review: I got the free trial of this app but thought it was a bit pricey. I was sent a discount email and decided to pull the trigger. This thing is going to be a huge time saver! I was using Google docs to plan and keep recipes but it was burdensome and disorganized. At full price I would spend just over a dollar a week and it is easily going to save me an hour or two of time.

title: I have never been wowed with an app till now
review: I saw an ad on TikTok. Once dl and opened I realized it was a paid subscription app which was off putting, but then it had a free 2 week trial. I am impressed with how easy it is to just import recipes from whatever you are using - both social media apps and browser. Once imported the layout is clean and aesthetically pleasing.

title: Great concept - need to fix some issues
review: I think this idea is brilliant. I purchased the yearly subscription because I saw the value. Right off the bat I had many recipes that they wouldn't save, so I gave it another week and those seemed to have resolved. It could import in both English and Portuguese. Definitely helped me keep my recipes in line. Worth the price. Cons: they need to fix some bugs because there are still times where some recipes it still gives me an error.

title: A Life Changer for Us
review: I started cooking myself about 1 year ago, saving recipes here there and everywhere, and then couldn't find them. Adding to the frustration of finding a recipe was the shopping for the ingredients. Well this APP changed all that. I now have 30 Cook books by food type with all my download recipes in one easy to find place. From there we create a weekly meal plan together, and then with ReciMe we can create a shopping list.

title: awesome sauce
review: This is the most helpful tool ever! I love the way that it's laid out. It's so easy to use. It gives emojis right next to the ingredients and detailed instructions. It's full proof and so far I've downloaded five of my favorite Instagram recipes and I can't wait to actually try them!

title: It's great, but there are glitches with importing videos (updated review!)
review: The dev team is great with updates and improvements. I would like to suggest: when you add ingredients for a recipe to a grocery list, it would be nice to have the groceries icon on the bottom of the screen so you can go directly from the recipe to the grocery list. I love this app. I have over 75 recipes saved ranging from my own cookbook to web recipes and reels. The AI that is used to generate recipes is a little clunky, but most of the time gets you at least 90% of the way there.
